title: Jupyter Notebook Module Compiler
description: Compiles Jupyter notebooks for production readiness. Enforces linear top-to-bottom execution, adequate markdown documentation, functions extracted from repeated logic, cleared outputs before commit, no global state mutations, and reproducible execution.

error_codes.JN002: Notebook cells cannot run linearly (out-of-order dependency detected)
error_codes.JN003: Insufficient markdown documentation — notebook sections need explanations
error_codes.JN004: Notebook has stored outputs — clear outputs before committing (nbstripout)
error_codes.JN005: Repeated code blocks not extracted into functions
error_codes.JN006: Global variable mutated across cells without reset — hidden state risk
error_codes.JN007: No random seed set — notebook results are not reproducible
